description: Create temp doc, read artboard rect, rename artboard, verify name round trip, cleanup
source: var d = app.documents.add(); try { var ab = d.artboards[0]; var r1 = ab.artboardRect; ab.name = 'main-board'; return {count: d.artboards.length, first: [r1[0], r1[1], r1[2], r1[3]], name: ab.name}; } finally { try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
